# Coverage-gate waivers — a one-way RATCHET, not a parking lot.
#
# Each line is surface (a CLI command or an API operation) that has NO referencing
# test yet. The coverage gate (cmd/dejima/coverage_gate_test.go) credits these as
# "known, tracked gaps" so the gate is green, while still FAILING on any NEW
# untested command/op that is not listed here.
#
# Rules enforced by the gate itself:
#   - Add a test for an entry, then DELETE its line. (A waived entry that gains a
#     test is flagged as a STALE waiver and fails CI — the ratchet only tightens.)
#   - A line that matches no current command/op is an ORPHAN waiver and fails CI.
#   - Adding a NEW line is a deliberate, reviewed act — prefer writing the test.
#
# Format:  cli <command path>        e.g.  cli agent config
#          api <METHOD> <path>       e.g.  api POST /v1/islands/{name}/hibernate
#
# See docs/testing/coverage-gate.md.
#
# The entries below are host-mutating, interactive, or network-bound and cannot
# be exercised hermetically in CI (no Docker, no real macOS host, no terminal).
# They are owned by the live tier-3 suites on the Mac-mini runner — see
# scripts/tier3/ and docs/testing/test-coverage-matrix.md §13/§14/§15.

cli auth push         # pushes host Claude/GitHub creds — needs a logged-in host
cli service uninstall # removes the launchd/systemd daemon service (tier3)

# Local-model endpoints that shell out to the backend CLI (ollama / install
# script) — side-effectful, so not hit in surface tests. THIS is the half that
# would need an injectable LocalBackend on the server; the CLI commands in front
# of them are invoked against a stub daemon in local_cli_test.go and must not be
# read as covering these. Backend logic is covered by internal/localmodel unit
# tests; the read-only GETs and /off are exercised in TestSurfaceLocalModels.
api POST /v1/local/install
api POST /v1/local/models/{name}/pull
api DELETE /v1/local/models/{name}

# Relaunches a real tmux session in the container (kill + re-create) — needs a
# live island, so not hit in surface tests. Covered by the restart-checklist TUI
# test (TestRestartChecklist), the CLI test (TestAgentRestartCommand), and the
# restartAgentSession/handler logic.
api POST /v1/islands/{name}/agents/{id}/restart

# Commands that cannot be INVOKED in a test, revealed when the gate stopped
# accepting a mention as evidence (issue #335). The side effect has to be IN THE
# COMMAND for this to hold — a command that only calls the daemon can be invoked
# against a stub, and two entries that were here have been replaced by exactly
# that (local_cli_test.go). Reviewed by d1, who found both.
#
#   voice install   — voicein.Install runs Homebrew or the distro package
#                     manager IN THIS PROCESS (voice.go:158). No daemon in
#                     between, so the stub trick cannot reach it, and every
#                     platform the CLI builds for is Supported() — linux, darwin
#                     and windows all return recorders — so there is no
#                     unsupported-platform branch for a CI invocation to stop at
#                     either. The decision logic is internal/voicein's
#                     TestPlanInstall (+ the checksum pin); `voice status` and
#                     `voice device` are invoked in cli_invocation_test.go.
#
#   github connect  — NOT because of the device flow. A `--token` invocation
#                     never reaches it: github.go:67-69 returns
#                     connectGitHubViaToken first, so a test taking the obvious
#                     path would find the device-flow reason false and delete
#                     this line. The binding reason is one layer in —
#                     connectGitHubViaToken calls githubid.VerifyToken, and
#                     apiBase("") hardcodes https://api.github.com with no
#                     override (internal/githubid/repos.go:34-40), so the token
#                     path makes a real network call to GitHub. Make apiBase
#                     injectable and this waiver goes; that is a change to argue
#                     on its own merits, not to smuggle in as test-enablement.
#                     Beneath it, internal/api's TestGitHubDeviceFlow{,Disabled}
#                     cover the exchange, TestDeviceFlowUnconfiguredDetection the
#                     unconfigured case, and TestNewGithubConnectCmdShape the
#                     command itself.
cli voice install
cli github connect
